title: Consistent spectral recovery of smooth reversible diffusion tensors at a fixed lag

exact_checked_claims.claim: For each fixed smooth symmetric uniformly elliptic S and positive normalized smooth invariant density mu on a known bounded connected smooth domain, with known fixed bounds and stationary exact observations at known fixed positive lag under conormal reflection, the specified measurable estimator is almost surely locally uniformly consistent for S and separately fitted div S on every interior compact, on one event.

exact_checked_claims.location: Theorem 2 and consistency argument, pages 4 and 6-7
exact_checked_claims.claim: The ellipticity-projected tensor converges in global L2; the density converges in global C2; covariance 2S/mu and drift divS/mu converge locally uniformly. All sample sizes use dyadic prefixes. Any positive deterministic ridge tending to zero suffices.
Known-domain signed boundary extension and convolution give the required C2 and C2,2 bias convergence and polynomial derivative bounds; positivity and exact mass preservation are unnecessary.

Conormal elliptic regularity gives smooth positive-time pair density. Markov endpoint conditioning controls overlapping pairs; logarithmic bandwidth and dyadic nets give simultaneous almost-sure derivative convergence.

Derivative-sensitive kernel convergence gives H-to-C2 smoothing convergence; continuous functions t_+^2 and t_+^2 log(t) yield stable normal equations despite negative modes, zero crossings, repetitions and small positive eigenvalues.

All positive population modes span full local gradient/Hessian jets by compactly supported cutoff functions and graph-norm spectral approximation; local limiting normal matrices are coercive for each fixed truth and compact.
Finite Gram formulas are basis invariant and Borel without inversion of a possibly singular feature Gram matrix; measurable eigenbasis selection is unnecessary.

exact_checked_claims.location: Supplementary classical_regularization_application.md and mathematical sections of independent_classical_derivation.md
exact_checked_claims.claim: A separate Sobolev-penalized approximate-minimization estimator has a consistent existence route after verifying diffusion forward continuity, injectivity, dependent joint-density convergence and regularization balance. It does not establish the spectral fit or historical firstness.

exact_remaining_gap: No substantive mathematical gap identified for the exact stated theorem. Limitations and independence exposure below remain; no broader scope or novelty certification is inferred.
limitations: Review conclusion is not human peer review, a proof-assistant certificate or a worldwide priority certificate.
Pointwise at each fixed smooth truth; no convergence rate, class-uniform conditioning or minimax optimality.
No general-domain finite-precision implementation, quadrature or eigensolver error control was claimed or verified.
No nonreversible, rough-coefficient, unknown-domain, sensor-noise, nonstationary-start or ordinary-normal anisotropic extension.
No global unprojected tensor convergence, global divergence convergence, or derivative consistency of the estimated tensor.
All positive empirical modes are retained; the theorem gives no prescribed fixed finite-mode cutoff.
Prior-literature coverage is bounded; the publisher-final 2011 Crommelin-Vanden-Eijnden body and exhaustive novelty were not certified.
